snippet.description:

But, for skateboarders, it's one of New York City's most storied spots— a collection of stair sets, handrails, and gaps that have been skated for decades by everyone from local kids to some of the biggest names in skateboarding.

This is Groundwork: Brick 9.

snippet.title: The Road to War | Civil War
snippet.description:
The Road to War | Civil War - A powerful historical documentary revealing how the first battles of the Civil War changed America forever.

The Road to War | Civil War

Director: Edward Feuerherd (Production: Creation Films)
Writers: Edward Feuerherd
Stars: Historians and Civil War experts
Genre: Historical Documentary, War History
Country: United States
Language: English (German version available)
Also Known As: Die ersten Schlachten des Amerikanischen Bürgerkriegs
Release Date: 2008
Filming Location: United States

Synopsis:
The Road to War examines the dramatic outbreak of the American Civil War and the first major confrontations between Union and Confederate forces. Through expert analysis and historical reconstruction, the documentary explores how early battles shaped military strategy, political resolve and the future of the divided nation.

Reviews:
A compelling and intense look at the opening phase of America’s bloodiest conflict. The documentary combines historical insight with vivid storytelling to bring the first battles to life.

snippet.title: From Dancehall to Reggaeton, Exhibit Explores the Power of Music as Protest
snippet.description:
A new contemporary art exhibition explores the evolution and spiritual roots of what’s arguably the Caribbean’s two most popular music genres: dance hall and reggaeton.
 
“Dancing the Revolution: From Dancehall to Reggaetón” at the Museum of Contemporary Art (@mcachicago) is a showcase that can move you, both emotionally and physically, as it takes you through the history.
 
WTTW News reporter Joanna Hernandez recently met with its curator, Carla Acevedo-Yates, to learn more.
 
Story & Video: Joanna Hernandez/WTTW News
#ChicagoTonightWTTW #wttwnews
